verification: Official upstream HTTPS clone; commit, tree and annotated tag target were checked with git object commands. The tag is not treated as a signed vendor identity assertion.
toolchain: Rust 1.95.0, as pinned by upstream codex-rs/rust-toolchain.toml

credential_profile.profile_default: default (1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens)
credential_profile.permissions: directories 0700 and files 0600 on Unix; protected user-only DACL on Windows; never stored in auth.json or a keyring
credential_profile.import: codex login --cc-lb-session (bounded 64 KiB JSON on stdin after configuration and destination validation; no token arguments or environment variables; refuses to replace an existing session)
credential_profile.bootstrap_provenance: The authorized executor passes the admin issuance response (Cache-Control: no-store) through memory or private storage. The client holds no admin credential and contacts no bootstrap endpoint.
credential_profile.metadata: The runtime id_token is the actual local access token, never a generated vendor identity. Issuer, user and workspace metadata must match the stored record.
credential_profile.renewal: POST {origin}/oauth/token, Authorization: Bearer <renewal_token>, body {"grant_type":"refresh_token","expected_workspace_generation":<stored u64>}; the response is committed only if the stored session is unchanged.
credential_profile.workspace_switch: POST {origin}/backend-api/accounts/switch-workspace-token with the access bearer; response {access_token, workspace_generation} must carry a higher generation and matching local metadata. Rollback is a reverse exchange.
credential_profile.revocation: POST {origin}/oauth/revoke, Authorization: Bearer <renewal_token>, body {}; only 204 counts as server-confirmed. codex logout exits non-zero when the session was erased locally without confirmation.

account_metadata: The app-server Account response carries authSource "cc-lb-local" only when the server-side credential is a local session; vendor responses omit the field.
not_supported_in_cc_lb_profile: Vendor ChatGPT, API-key, access-token and device-code login (rejected; the profile accepts only an imported local session)
Agent Identity and runtime agent registration (a local session is not vendor identity proof)
Enterprise IdP token exchange from the account grant (the renewal credential is never exported as an OAuth grant)
Internal Cloud conversation preview over native gRPC ThreadService and its /v2/models catalog (inventory CX03, out of scope): rejected before any credential is read; no proxy route exists
qa_commands: cd <isolated-source>/codex-rs && cargo test --locked -p codex-app-server-protocol -p codex-app-server -p codex-app-server-client
support_status: Maintained source patch, not stock CLI support and not an upstream release. The patch has never been compiled, formatted, linted or tested; Cargo.lock and the app-server protocol schema files were edited by hand and need generator parity checks. TLS recorder runs, real client runs and the full inventory acceptance are pending.
